name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v2520: A cold review found None meant two opposite things inside the instrument built to stop exactly that - the spy records None on conversion failure and the argument itself could legitimately be None, so the message blamed THE SPY either way. My first fix only moved the conflation: with a distinct sentinel, a census passing None made set(None) raise inside the spy and it was recorded as an instrument fault again. The spy keeps the raw value beside the snapshot now and the call is judged on the raw while the instrument is judged on the snapshot.
